title: film.json
description: One film's settings for kit/film.mjs: what the film is, how it renders and which records its final writes. It lives at motion/films/<slug>/film.json; films/_smoke/film.json is the example. Paths are relative to the film's folder, except script.source and legacyDraft, which are relative to motion/ (a path that starts with out/ means the folder that holds the finals). film.mjs validates every file against this schema before it renders. A published film's film.json is tracked, so it names voices by name and never by ID.

$comment.description: A note for the next reader; film.mjs ignores it.

slug.description: The film's folder name under motion/films/. It must equal the folder's name.

kind.description: blog: a blog film. series: a translation series film. kb: a knowledge base film built from kit/kb/, whose final also runs what kit/kb/deliver.sh ran (node kit/kb/build.mjs --check before the renders, the poster at lib/kb-data.js's KB.poster unless poster is set, the kb-inputs hash in the master's comment, and the web, captions and seo records). brand: a brand or announcement film. short: a sting, a demo, a kit example or other short media.

path.description: The render path. software renders with --no-browser-gpu (SwiftShader); series films with large animated type use it, because two hardware GPU renders of nishi-amane differed in 240 frames under load while the software pair was byte-identical. gpu leaves the GPU on, as every gem smoke film (the blog films, the kit end card) renders, because the software path moves the smoke by up to 7 levels.

fps.description: The delivery frame rate of renders A and B. A draft is always 30 fps.

workers.description: Render workers for the draft and the delivery pair. One worker streams frames to the encoder and needs 5 GiB free; more workers write every frame to disk first and need 8 GiB.

timeout.description: Minutes one render may run. A render still running then is stopped, by its own process IDs, and the lock goes to the next ticket.

poster.description: The poster, out/<slug>.png. {"frame": n} takes frame n of the master, selected by index. {"at": seconds} takes a lossless snapshot of the composition at that time on the film's render path. Needed when records lists poster, except for a kb film.

records.description: The records the final writes. poster: out/<slug>.png. sheets: the contact sheet out/sheets/<slug>.png and .webp (kit/contact-sheet.sh). checking: the checking sheet out/_sheets/<slug>.png. script: the script page out/scripts/<slug>.md (kit/script-export.py) from the final's transcript. credits: CREDITS.txt copied to out/<slug>.credits.txt. web, captions, seo: a kb film's web encode, WebVTT captions and VideoObject. Default: poster, sheets, checking, script and credits, and for a kb film also web, captions and seo. A master over 50 MB always gets a share copy, out/<slug>-share.mp4.

checking.description: The checking sheet tool, run as python3 <tool> <master> <sheet.png>. Default: tools/sheet.py, or kit/kb/check-sheet.py for a kb film.

source.description: The reviewed script table kit/script-export.py reads. Default: out/scripts/source/<slug>.json; a kb film writes it with kit/kb/script-source.mjs.

voices.description: The voices line of the page, by name, such as "Narrator: Frederick Surrey; reader: Jane".

version.description: The cut's label on the page, such as v2. Leave it out for none.

sound.description: The master's sound targets: false for a silent film, or the integrated loudness, the tolerance and the true peak ceiling. Default: -16 LUFS within 0.5, at or below -1 dBTP.

legacyDraft.description: Drafts from before film.mjs at their old paths, besides out/_draft-<slug>.mp4, which is always read. status shows the first that exists while films/<slug>/renders/draft.mp4 is missing; the next draft moves them to the archive.
